title: Team
description: People on your reseller team who can sign in to this portal.

filters.search: Search by name, email or Roviq ID

empty.title: No members match
empty.description: Try another search or clear the filters.
empty.noDataDescription: Invite a colleague to give them access to this portal.

loadError: Could not load the team. Refresh the page to try again.

inviteDialog.title: Invite a team member
inviteDialog.description: If this email already has a Roviq account, that account is added to your team. Otherwise a new account is created and a temporary password is sent to the address.
inviteDialog.roleHint: You can give roles up to your own.

roleDialog.title: Change role of {name}
roleDialog.description: The new role applies at once. They are asked to sign in again only if their session cannot be renewed.
roleDialog.unchanged: Choose a different role to save.

deactivateDialog.title: Deactivate {name}?
deactivateDialog.description: They are signed out at once and cannot sign in to this portal until reactivated. Their Roviq account and any other memberships stay as they are.

reactivateDialog.title: Reactivate {name}?
reactivateDialog.description: They can sign in to this portal again with their existing role.

roleHelp.reseller_full_admin: Manages institutes, billing and the team.
roleHelp.reseller_support_admin: Reads everything, can view as institute users, and manages support and viewer members.

detail.title: Team member
detail.notFound: This team member was not found.
detail.sessionsHidden: You can see sessions only for yourself and for members you manage.
detail.activityHidden: You do not have access to the audit log.

errors.FORBIDDEN: You are not allowed to do this.
errors.TEAM_MEMBER_NOT_FOUND: This team member no longer exists. Refresh the page.
errors.TEAM_MEMBER_ALREADY_EXISTS: This person is already on your team. If they are inactive, reactivate them from the list.
errors.TEAM_MEMBER_EMAIL_UNAVAILABLE: This email cannot be used for a team member. Use another address.
errors.TEAM_MEMBER_SELF_CHANGE: You cannot change your own role or status. Ask another admin.
errors.TEAM_ROLE_NOT_ASSIGNABLE: This role is above what you, or your reseller plan, can assign.
errors.TEAM_MEMBER_STATUS_UNCHANGED: This member's status has already changed. Refresh the page.
